=== FILE: test_crc8_block.py ===
"""cocotb tests for crc8_block, written from interface_spec.md (not from the RTL)."""
import random

import cocotb
from cocotb.clock import Clock
from cocotb.triggers import FallingEdge, ReadOnly, RisingEdge, Timer

START = 0xFF   # spec 2: start value
POLY = 0x07    # spec 2.2: x^8 + x^2 + x + 1


def model_take(running, byte):
    """Spec 2.2, clause by clause: for each bit 7..0, XOR it into the top bit,
    shift left one place, and if the bit shifted out was 1, XOR with 0x07."""
    r = running & 0xFF
    for i in range(7, -1, -1):
        bit = (byte >> i) & 1
        r ^= bit << 7                  # XOR data bit into top bit
        out = (r >> 7) & 1             # bit about to be shifted out
        r = (r << 1) & 0xFF            # shift left one place
        if out:
            r ^= POLY
    return r


def model_crc(running):
    """Spec 2.3: crc is the running value with every bit inverted."""
    return running ^ 0xFF


def as_int(sig):
    v = sig.value
    if hasattr(v, "to_unsigned"):
        return v.to_unsigned()
    if hasattr(v, "integer"):
        return v.integer
    return int(v)


class Bench:
    def __init__(self, dut):
        self.dut = dut
        self.running = None
        self.checks = 0

    async def start(self):
        cocotb.start_soon(Clock(self.dut.clk, 10, "ns").start())
        self.dut.rst_n.value = 0
        self.dut.init.value = 0
        self.dut.valid.value = 0
        self.dut.data.value = 0
        await FallingEdge(self.dut.clk)

    async def cycle(self, rst_n=1, init=0, valid=0, data=0, tag=""):
        """Drive on the falling edge, apply one rising edge, update the model,
        and compare crc after the design has settled."""
        dut = self.dut
        dut.rst_n.value = rst_n
        dut.init.value = init
        dut.valid.value = valid
        dut.data.value = data & 0xFF
        await RisingEdge(dut.clk)
        if not rst_n:
            self.running = START                       # CRC-RESET
        elif init:
            self.running = START                       # CRC-INIT (wins over valid)
        elif valid:
            self.running = model_take(self.running, data)  # CRC-POLY / CRC-ORDER
        # else: CRC-HOLD, running value unchanged
        await ReadOnly()
        got = as_int(dut.crc)
        exp = model_crc(self.running)
        assert got == exp, (
            f"[{tag}] crc mismatch: got 0x{got:02X} expected 0x{exp:02X} "
            f"(rst_n={rst_n} init={init} valid={valid} data=0x{data & 0xFF:02X})"
        )
        self.checks += 1
        await FallingEdge(dut.clk)
        return got

    async def reset(self, cycles=3):
        for _ in range(cycles):
            await self.cycle(rst_n=0, tag="reset")


def test_model_selfcheck():
    """Hand-computed from spec 2.2 so a wrong model cannot hide behind itself."""
    assert model_crc(START) == 0x00
    assert model_crc(model_take(START, 0x00)) == 0x0C
    assert model_crc(model_take(START, 0xFF)) == 0xFF


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=50, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_reset_and_empty(dut):
    """CRC-RESET, CRC-EMPTY: after reset with no byte taken, crc is 0x00."""
    test_model_selfcheck()
    tb = Bench(dut)
    await tb.start()
    await tb.reset()
    assert as_int(dut.crc) == 0x00, "crc after reset is not 0x00"
    # reset while valid is offered still loads the start value
    await tb.cycle(valid=1, data=0x5A, tag="byte")
    await tb.cycle(rst_n=0, valid=1, data=0xA5, tag="reset+valid")
    assert as_int(dut.crc) == 0x00, "reset with valid did not load start value"
    assert tb.checks >= 5


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=50, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_known_vectors(dut):
    """CRC-POLY, CRC-ORDER, CRC-FINAL with hand-computed single-byte values."""
    tb = Bench(dut)
    await tb.start()
    await tb.reset()
    got = await tb.cycle(valid=1, data=0x00, tag="0x00")
    assert got == 0x0C, f"crc of 0x00 from start is 0x{got:02X}, expected 0x0C"
    await tb.cycle(init=1, tag="init")
    got = await tb.cycle(valid=1, data=0xFF, tag="0xFF")
    assert got == 0xFF, f"crc of 0xFF from start is 0x{got:02X}, expected 0xFF"
    # single-bit bytes expose bit-order and reflection errors
    for b in range(8):
        await tb.cycle(init=1, tag="init")
        await tb.cycle(valid=1, data=1 << b, tag=f"bit{b}")
    # a multi-byte frame
    await tb.cycle(init=1, tag="init")
    for byte in b"123456789":
        await tb.cycle(valid=1, data=byte, tag="frame")
    assert tb.checks >= 30


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=50, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_init_wins_over_valid(dut):
    """CRC-INIT: init with valid at the same edge reloads; the byte is dropped."""
    tb = Bench(dut)
    await tb.start()
    await tb.reset()
    await tb.cycle(valid=1, data=0x3C, tag="byte")
    await tb.cycle(valid=1, data=0xC3, tag="byte")
    assert as_int(dut.crc) != 0x00, "precondition: running value must differ from start"
    await tb.cycle(init=1, valid=1, data=0x77, tag="init+valid")
    assert as_int(dut.crc) == 0x00, "init did not win over valid"
    await tb.cycle(init=1, valid=0, tag="init alone")
    assert as_int(dut.crc) == 0x00


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=50, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_hold(dut):
    """CRC-HOLD: valid low and init low keep the running value, whatever data is."""
    tb = Bench(dut)
    await tb.start()
    await tb.reset()
    await tb.cycle(valid=1, data=0x91, tag="byte")
    held = as_int(dut.crc)
    assert held != 0x00, "precondition: running value must differ from start"
    for d in (0x00, 0xFF, 0x55, 0xAA, 0x91):
        got = await tb.cycle(valid=0, data=d, tag="hold")
        assert got == held, f"crc changed while holding: 0x{got:02X} vs 0x{held:02X}"


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=50, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_reset_mid_frame(dut):
    """A reset in the middle of a frame restarts from the start value."""
    tb = Bench(dut)
    await tb.start()
    await tb.reset()
    for byte in (0xDE, 0xAD):
        await tb.cycle(valid=1, data=byte, tag="frame-a")
    await tb.cycle(rst_n=0, tag="mid reset")
    assert as_int(dut.crc) == 0x00
    for byte in (0xBE, 0xEF):
        await tb.cycle(valid=1, data=byte, tag="frame-b")
    exp = model_crc(model_take(model_take(START, 0xBE), 0xEF))
    assert as_int(dut.crc) == exp


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=50, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_crc_is_combinational(dut):
    """CRC-FINAL: crc follows the running value with no extra clock edge."""
    tb = Bench(dut)
    await tb.start()
    await tb.reset()
    await tb.cycle(valid=1, data=0x42, tag="byte")
    exp = model_crc(model_take(START, 0x42))
    await Timer(1, "ns")
    assert as_int(dut.crc) == exp, "crc not updated within the edge's cycle"


@cocotb.test(timeout_time=500, timeout_unit="us")
async def test_random_scoreboard(dut):
    """Seeded random traffic; every cycle compared against the spec model."""
    tb = Bench(dut)
    await tb.start()
    await tb.reset()
    seen = {"take": 0, "hold": 0, "init": 0, "init_valid": 0, "reset": 0}
    for _ in range(2000):
        r = random.random()
        rst_n = 0 if r < 0.02 else 1
        init = 1 if random.random() < 0.08 else 0
        valid = 1 if random.random() < 0.7 else 0
        data = random.randrange(256)
        if not rst_n:
            seen["reset"] += 1
        elif init and valid:
            seen["init_valid"] += 1
        elif init:
            seen["init"] += 1
        elif valid:
            seen["take"] += 1
        else:
            seen["hold"] += 1
        await tb.cycle(rst_n=rst_n, init=init, valid=valid, data=data, tag="random")
    for k, n in seen.items():
        assert n > 0, f"random phase never reached scenario {k}"
    assert tb.checks >= 2000
